title: Enterprise Multi-Document RAG Engine (Phase 1)
problem: Client had 15,000 regulatory compliance PDFs with poor searchability and 35% hallucination rate.
solution: Designed hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with Cross-Encoder reranking and citation-claim verification pipeline.
outcome_metrics: Reduced hallucination to <1.5%, boosted retrieval Recall@5 from 62% to 94.2%, saved 400 hours/month of analyst time.

title: Customer Churn Prediction Baseline & API (Phase 1)
problem: Telecom provider experiencing 12% annual subscriber churn without early-warning signals.
solution: Engineered 45 behavioral features from raw call/billing logs, trained tuned XGBoost model with SHAP explanations.
outcome_metrics: Achieved 0.88 ROC-AUC, 81% precision in identifying high-risk churners 30 days prior to cancellation.

title: Local vLLM Inference Gateway with Rate Limiting (Phase 1)
problem: Client needed HIPAA-compliant on-premises LLM serving without external API egress.
solution: Deployed dual RTX 4090 vLLM cluster with continuous batching and token-bucket rate limiting.
outcome_metrics: Achieved 145 tokens/sec throughput with p95 latency under 220ms; zero data leakage.

title: Automated Code Review Agent with LangGraph (Phase 1)
problem: PRs waiting 48 hours for preliminary lint, security, and schema reviews.
solution: Built multi-agent reviewer graph with parallel security, type, and style critique loops.
outcome_metrics: Cut median PR turnaround time by 60%; caught 94% of syntax/schema regressions prior to human review.

title: E-Commerce Semantic Search & Re-ranking (Phase 1)
problem: Standard keyword search yielded 28% zero-result queries on long-tail product queries.
solution: Built bi-encoder embeddings with reciprocal rank fusion with existing Elasticsearch index.
outcome_metrics: Zero-result queries dropped to 2.1%; search-to-cart conversion increased by 19.4%.
